about: The secreta of the formulary “Commemoration of the Baptism of Our Lord Jesus Christ” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We bring offerings unto Thee, O Lord, for the manifestation of Thy newborn Son, humbly beseeching that as He is the author of our gifts, so may He also be their merciful receiver, Jesus Christ our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
